name.local: グロービス・キャピタル・パートナーズ

strategy.thesis: Backs startups looking to update large industries in Japan that can be expanded globally, aiming to create unicorn and decacorn companies; invests 'first to last' from the seed stage as a lead investor.

summary.en: GLOBIS Capital Partners (founded 1996) is one of Japan's most prominent independent VC firms, with over US$1.8 billion aggregated AUM and Fund VII at ¥72.7 billion. It invests from seed onward as a lead investor in startups transforming large Japanese industries for global scale.
summary.local: 1996年設立の独立系大手VC。累計運用資産1,800億円超、7号ファンドは727億円規模。日本の大型産業をアップデートしグローバル展開を目指すスタートアップにシード期からリード投資。

name.local: 株式会社ジャフコ グループ

funds.name: JAFCO 2025 fund (AI / space / nuclear fusion focus)

strategy.thesis: Japan's oldest and largest independent venture/buyout platform; invests seed through growth across IT, life science/biotech, fintech and deep tech, with capacity to lead. Listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (Prime, 8595).

summary.en: JAFCO Group (founded 1973) is Japan's oldest and largest independent VC, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. It has cumulative funds under management of ¥1.2 trillion, over 4,200 investments and 1,042 IPOs to date, and launched a new ¥100 billion fund in 2025 targeting AI, space and nuclear fusion.

summary.en: WiL (World Innovation Lab, co-founded 2014) is a Palo Alto- and Tokyo-headquartered VC bridging startups and large corporations in the U.S. and Japan. Total committed capital exceeds US$1.9 billion, with 15 unicorns in portfolio and exits including Mercari, Asana, Wise and Auth0.

summary.en: ITOCHU Technology Ventures (ITV, established 2000) is the venture arm tied to trading house ITOCHU. In March 2025 it closed its largest-ever fund, Technology Ventures VI, at 16.1 billion yen (ITOCHU itself investing 2.5 billion yen). Across Funds I-V it invested in 180+ companies totaling over 39 billion yen, focusing on AI, healthcare, decarbonization and space.
